                    steps:


                

                    

                        
1. Deploy Backend
                            Files

                        
    
                            
  • • api/metaIntegration.js
                            
    • 
                            
  • • routes/meta.js
                            
    • 
                        

                    


                    

                        
2. Set Environment
                            Variables

                        
    
                            
  • • FACEBOOK_APP_ID
                            
    • 
                            
  • • FACEBOOK_APP_SECRET
                            
    • 
                            
  • • APP_URL
                            
    • 
                            
  • • MARKETING_HUB_ENCRYPTION_KEY
                            
    • 
                        

                    


                    

                        
3. Configure Firestore
                        

                        
Create required collections and set
                            TTL policies

                    

                


                
📖 See META_DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md in project
                    root for detailed instructions
